body:
**Summary**

Updates babel from 7.8.3 to 7.9.6 to support Node.js 14.x+ (including 13.x) as development environment.

https://babeljs.io/blog/2020/03/16/7.9.0

Increases the prod package size by 0.15 kB (cf. the previous increment: 734b2f46)

**Result**

Closes #4639 

Replaces #4640
